name: opus-flo-server
description: Opus Flo – shared database server for NAS/local deployment

scripts.package:win: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output opus-flo-server.exe
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --output opus-flo-server-mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output opus-flo-server-linux
